_about: Devices whose setup was verified in tests or by users (ADR-0034). Only add a device with a source. method: auto = Teach-In button, actuator = Actuator Teach-In, manual = Manual Entry. art: illustration static/img/teach/<art>.svg, one per device type.

devices.name: Eltako FSR61 switch actuator
teach: Upper rotary switch to LRN (not CLR), the LED flashes.
Lower rotary switch to the pushbutton function you want (see its manual).
Actuator Teach-In: type Switch, a free sender offset, Send Teach-In. The LED stops flashing: learned.
Turn the upper rotary switch back to its operating position.
Click Save device under the teach-in result.
devices.id_where: The NP types send a confirmation every time they switch. Switch it by hand or with a learned pushbutton: its ID appears in the telegram list on the Dashboard. The address is only needed for the state in Home Assistant.
notes: No state in Home Assistant: confirmation telegrams are off from the factory. Upper dial to CLR, then within 10 s the lower dial 3 times to the LEFT stop and back: toggles them on (3 times to the RIGHT deletes everything).
While in LRN it learns the next telegram it hears, any of them: pause automations that switch other Eltako devices during the teach-in.
ON and OFF shown the wrong way round: tick Invert reported state on the device.
devices.source: Test devices, ADR-0008, ADR-0013, FSR61NP manual, forum post 84

devices.name: Eltako FUD61 universal dimmer
teach: Upper rotary switch to LRN, the LED flashes.
Actuator Teach-In: type Dimmer, a free sender offset, Send Teach-In. The LED stops flashing: learned.
Turn the upper rotary switch back to its operating position.
Click Save device under the teach-in result.
devices.id_where: It reports its state after every change; dim it by hand and its ID appears in the telegram list.
notes: Brightness works because the dimmer is taught the A5-38-08 dimming telegram, not a rocker.

devices.name: Eltako FD62NPN dimmer
teach: Place it right next to the USB stick: its receiver is weak while learning.
Press the rotary knob 4 times short and once long (over 2 s). The lamp flickers: learn mode.
Actuator Teach-In: type Dimmer, a free sender offset, Send Teach-In within 30 s. The lamp flickers again: learned.
Click Save device under the teach-in result.
devices.id_where: Dim it by hand: its confirmation shows its ID in the telegram list.

devices.name: Eltako FL62 switching relay
teach: Switch learn mode on as its manual describes (62 series: learn mode on or off, no learn positions).
Actuator Teach-In: type Switch, a free sender offset. Click Send Teach-In 3 times in a row: that teaches a universal pushbutton.
Click Save device under the teach-in result.
devices.id_where: The NP type confirms every switching; its ID appears in the telegram list.
notes: The number of telegrams decides what is learned: 3 universal pushbutton, 4 directional pushbutton, 5 central on, 6 central off.

devices.name: Eltako FSB61 shutter actuator (also OPUS 561.164)
teach: Upper rotary switch to LRN (not CLR), the LED flashes.
Lower rotary switch to GS2 or GS3. GS4 and GR are static: the motor only runs while the button is held, so a tap moves it a fraction of a second.
Actuator Teach-In: type Blind, a free sender offset, Send Teach-In. The LED stops flashing: learned.
Turn the upper rotary switch back to its operating position.
Click Save device and enter the travel time (seconds for a full run).
devices.id_where: It reports end positions and run times; run it once by hand and its ID appears in the telegram list.
notes: No state in Home Assistant: confirmation telegrams are off from the factory. Upper dial to CLR, then within 10 s the lower dial 3 times to the LEFT stop and back: toggles them on (3 times to the RIGHT deletes everything).
While in LRN it learns the next telegram it hears, any of them: pause automations that switch other Eltako devices during the teach-in.
Static mode wanted anyway: set Press duration on the device so the button is held long enough.
OPUS 561.164 is a rebranded FSB61NP; on it GS1 also behaves statically (user report, confirmed on two actuators).
Runs the wrong way: tick Reverse direction.
With a travel time set, Home Assistant shows a position.

Stop is a tap of the last direction; the app skips it when the actuator reported it already stands still. For a real stop and positions: the second teach-in with type Blind position (GFVS, sent once) and Position control. Only the newer FSB61NP (manual 30200430) has GFVS; the older one (manual 30200420) does not.
devices.source: Issue #39, ADR-0014, FSB61NP manual, forum post 84, issue #49

devices.name: Eltako FJ62 shutter actuator
teach: Switch learn mode on as its manual describes (62 series: learn mode on or off, no learn positions).
Actuator Teach-In: type Blind, a free sender offset. Click Send Teach-In 4 times in a row: that teaches a directional pushbutton.
Click Save device and enter the travel time.
For moving to a position: a second teach-in with type Blind position (GFVS), sent ONCE, then tick Position control on the device.
devices.id_where: It reports end positions and run times; run it once and its ID appears in the telegram list.
notes: Never send the GFVS teach-in repeatedly: it locks the learn mode.
Runs the wrong way: tick Reverse direction.

devices.name: Eltako Series 14 on FAM14 (DIN rail)
devices.category: DIN rail actuators behind a FAM14 radio module
teach: One device in this app per channel: an FSR14-4x is four devices, each with its own sender offset.
Put the channel into learn mode as the actuator's manual describes; the LED flashes.
Actuator Teach-In: Actuator address = the channel's ID from PCT14, type Switch (FSB14: Blind), Send Teach-In. The LED stops flashing: learned.
Click Save device under the teach-in result. Repeat for the next channel with the next offset.
devices.id_where: The bus actuators have no printed radio ID. Connect PCT14 to the FAM14, right-click the device list, refresh it: it shows the base ID and the ID of every channel.
notes: No state in Home Assistant: the FAM14 only sends confirmation telegrams with its top rotary switch on 2, 4 or 5 (FAM14 manual).
Disconnect PCT14 from the FAM14 afterwards; while it is connected the FAM14 executes no radio commands.
devices.source: Forum posts 82 and 84, Eltako FAM14 manual

devices.name: Eltako FUD14 dimmer on FAM14 (DIN rail)
devices.category: DIN rail dimmer behind a FAM14 radio module
teach: Put the dimmer into learn mode as its manual describes; the LED flashes.
Actuator Teach-In: Actuator address = the dimmer's ID from PCT14, type Dimmer, a free sender offset, Send Teach-In. The LED stops flashing: learned.
Click Save device under the teach-in result.
devices.id_where: No printed radio ID. PCT14 shows it in the FAM14's device list (refresh).
notes: It confirms on and off with a rocker telegram, without the level. The app keeps the brightness you set (since 1.8.5-beta12).
No state in Home Assistant: the FAM14's top rotary switch must be on 2, 4 or 5.

devices.name: Micropelt radiator valve
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Hold the valve's button for 5 s. The app answers (green flash on the valve) and fills in the sender ID.
Save the device with that sender ID.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the valve's label.
notes: The valve only listens for a second after it sends. A value set in Home Assistant goes out with the next answer, after up to a few minutes. Command Pending shows it is waiting.
Until something is set it regulates to 21 °C.

devices.name: NodOn pilot wire heating module
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Put the module into pairing mode with its button as its manual describes. The app answers and fills in profile and sender ID.
Save the device.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the module's label.
notes: Entities: Pilot Wire Mode, Power, Energy. Power and energy are read every five minutes.

devices.name: NodOn 2-channel relay switch
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Put the module into pairing mode with its button as its manual describes. The app fills in profile and sender ID.
Save the first channel; the app then offers the second channel, pre-filled.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the module's label.
notes: Both channels share one address and one sender ID; that is correct here.

devices.name: NodOn roller shutter module
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Put the module into pairing mode with its button as its manual describes. The app fills in profile and sender ID.
Save the device.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the module's label.
notes: Position is set and reported by the module itself.

devices.name: NodOn Micro Smart Plug
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Put the plug into pairing mode with its button as its manual describes. The app fills in profile and sender ID.
Save the device.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the plug's label.
notes: Entities: switch, Power and Energy. Power comes with the plug's own reports, energy from a query every five minutes, which needs the sender ID.

devices.name: NodOn door and window contact
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Press the contact's button (LRN). The app fills in address and profile.
Save the device.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the label.
notes: On = open. Mounted the other way round: tick Invert on the device.

devices.name: OPUS greenNet blind actuator
teach: Pairing with OPUS actuators is not confirmed yet. Try Start Teach-In with the actuator in learn mode; if nothing is detected, enter it manually and report how it went.
Manual Entry: address from its label or from the telegram list, profile D2-05-02, type Blind, a free sender ID.
devices.id_where: Run it once with its own button: its status telegram shows its ID in the telegram list.
notes: Open, close, stop and position work; the tilt angle is not supported yet.
devices.source: Forum thread 1026367 (telegrams of a real device)

devices.id_where: Switch it with its own button: its status telegram shows its ID in the telegram list.

Manual Entry: address from its label or from the telegram list, profile D2-01-00, type Switch, a free sender ID.

devices.name: Wall switch / pushbutton (rocker)
teach: Rocker switches send no teach-in telegram, so Start Teach-In does not detect them.
Press a rocker: the switch appears in the telegram list on the Dashboard with its ID.
Manual Entry: that ID as address, profile F6-02-01, no actuator type.
devices.id_where: Telegram list after one press, or the label on the back of the switch module.
notes: A switch that should control an Eltako actuator directly is taught into the actuator, not into this app.

devices.name: Window handle (rocker type)
teach: These handles send no teach-in telegram.
Turn the handle once: it appears in the telegram list with its ID.
Manual Entry: that ID as address, profile F6-10-00.
devices.id_where: Telegram list after one turn, or the label on the handle.
notes: Handles with a 4BS profile (A5-14-09, A5-14-0A) send a teach-in and use Start Teach-In.

devices.name: Temperature, humidity or motion sensor (4BS)
teach: Click Start Teach-In.
Press the sensor's LRN button (often under the cover). Its teach-in telegram carries the profile; the app fills in address and profile.
Save the device.
devices.id_where: The teach-in fills it in. It is also on the label.
notes: A sensor without a LRN button sends normal data only: use Manual Entry with the profile from its datasheet.
